source.title: Life in CIL : Vishwakarma Puja Celebration @TheCivilGuruji #cilmt2026 #psujobs2026 #ytshorts
source.description:
In the coal-dusted heart of the colliery, Vishwakarma Puja transforms the harsh industrial expanse into a vibrant sanctuary. Miners wash down heavy excavators, dumpers, and haulers, adorning the massive machinery with bright marigold garlands and sacred vermilion. For one day, gritty soot yields to the sweet aroma of incense and camphor. Laborers and engineers unite before the divine cosmic architect, praying for underground safety, health, and prosperity before sharing festive prasad with their proud families.
